answer: Agents stake saffron tokens to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique ridge-shaped proof-of-work puzzle tied to their identity hash. A mirror contract records every solution; duplicating identities forces adversaries to redo the full puzzle per fake account while staking fresh tokens, so costs scale linearly with sybil count. Honest agents recover stake plus rewards, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
